title: Night: run the evaluation on gemma4:26b and record the report
goal: A report says whether the skill beats the baseline on the held-out cases, in Italian and English
acceptance: Owner 2026-11-27 in chat: "ok" to starting the first real skills, a Grover check for "controlla se è richiesta un'altra dose"; read-only.

A real-model run needs the owner's yes and a night model plan on a quiet Mac, from a development worktree at origin/main with node_modules installed, never ~/.nerv-app; OUT is a new private directory; the evaluation uses a throwaway NERV home, never ~/.nerv

Commands: node evals/skill-evaluation-run.mjs --package=skills/grover-dose.json --suite=evals/skill-evaluation-grover-dose-v1.json --fixtures=evals/skill-fixtures-grover-dose-v1.json --model=gemma4:26b --allow-models --execute --out=$OUT/grover-dose-26b.json; then NERV_HOME=$OUT/nerv-home node src/cli.ts skills stage skills/grover-dose.json and NERV_HOME=$OUT/nerv-home node src/cli.ts skills evaluate grover-dose 1.1.0 $OUT/grover-dose-26b.json gemma4:26b > $OUT/grover-dose-26b-report.json. 22 model calls of at most 120 s each (about 44 min at most; expected a few minutes). The same with --model=gemma4:12b if the night has room. The version evaluated is the one in skills/grover-dose.json on origin/main at night: 1.1.0 (F-153-T04, with the trigger phrases; 1.0.0 is its parent), which the night script reads from the package

The report (with-skill against baseline, holdout, escalation) is recorded in F-153 with the model; if the skill does not beat the baseline on the holdout cases in both languages, the instructions are revised in a new version before the owner is asked. No skill is promoted by the agent
privacy: Invented tent, pot and readings only in Git and tests; the owner's real Grover data stays on the owner's machines.
escalation: Any run of a real model needs the owner's yes first
A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-27: one overnight run and a short record. Not a measurement.
